cleanup.consolidate_marketplace_real.directive: Consolidate scripts/live/marketplace_real.py and marketplace_real_fp8.py into a single env-driven script scripts/live/marketplace_real.py that accepts --variant {bf16,fp8} (default bf16) and reads /tmp/rollout_<variant>.json + /tmp/trainer_<variant>.json (bf16 falls back to /tmp/rollout.json + /tmp/trainer.json). megatron.qwen3_moe_conversion_runbook.directive: Add scripts/live/megatron_convert_qwen3_moe.md — a self-contained runbook for converting Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B from HF to a Megatron torch-dist checkpoint on the spot instance using the slimerl/slime:latest docker image. The runbook must pin: (1) the docker image tag, (2) the exact docker run flags (--gpus all --ipc=host --shm-size=64g --ulimit memlock=-1 --ulimit stack=67108864) and volume mounts (host ~/megatron_conversion/{hf_model,megatron_ckpt,logs} → container /root/Qwen3-30B-A3B, /root/Qwen3-30B-A3B_torch_dist, /root/logs), (3) the conversion command (PYTHONPATH=/root/Megatron-LM/ torchrun --nproc-per-node 4 tools/convert_hf_to_torch_dist.py ${MODEL_ARGS[@]} --hf-checkpoint /root/Qwen3-30B-A3B/ --save /root/Qwen3-30B-A3B_torch_dist/), (4) the env vars the existing live scripts already read (MODEL=Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B, TRAINER_REFERENCE=megatron, DEVICE_*) so the resulting dist-ckpt feeds router_mismatch_lab without code changes, (5) disk budget (~200 GB peak), time budget (~60 min HF download + ~20 min conversion), and the spot-instance cleanup step. Cross-link from scripts/live/README.md and docs/future_research.md. No Python code changes — this is a doc-only entry. Evidence: the new runbook file path. Honor STEER.md global directives.
